RULES
Storylines only group events for readability: their events join the deck with the same rules, default weight rules.storylineWeight. Nothing in the code may reference a storyline or event id directly: everything goes through conditions, flags, next and ending.

CHECK EACH CHAIN (play or use debug autoplay with fixed choices, then report)
1. Mill: "Start building" sets millStarted -> "half built" card can appear -> "Feed them" sets millFed -> "mill is done" card. "Pause works" clears millStarted and ends the chain.
2. Bridge (from turn 8): "Plan it" -> guards card -> "Send guards" -> "bridge is finished" card only if safety >= 30 -> "Everyone" ends the run with the Great Bridge win ending.
3. Envoy (from turn 12): "Host them" queues the charter card as the very next card; "Refuse" leads to the camp card, "Send gifts" clears it.
4. Each once event appears at most once per run; a new run makes them available again.
5. The 10 endings can all be reached; endings found X/10 counts them correctly.
Report any chain that cannot complete and fix it in the data, not in the code.
